description: Wanderer turns NASA SPHEREx data into a public web tool for watching the sky move. Pick any spot and it pulls every SPHEREx image of it from NASA/IPAC IRSA, lines them up and lets you blink, swipe or flip through time. It finds moving objects, names known asteroids and comets with JPL data, follows comets like 3I/ATLAS and builds spectra. Built with Go, Python and React plus 3D views. We welcome people into astronomy data, design or video storytelling.
